The retained hypotheses give H a group structure and a locally finite-type structure morphism. ringKrullDim_stalk_unit_eq_topologicalKrullDim, which requires only [Field K], identifies dim H with its stalk dimension at the unit. The unit belongs to U, and ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight and coheight_eq_of_isOpenImmersion identify this with the coheight of that point in U. Order.coheight_le_krullDim gives dim H ≤ dim U; the inducing inclusion gives the reverse inequality. Finish with Scheme.reduction_topologicalKrullDim as before.
